{"consolidated_memory":"## Request timeout issues in services/auth/session_store.py - Two separate incidents

### Incident 1: 2026-02-06 - Clock skew between hosts
**Location:** services/auth/session_store.py (authentication side)

**Trigger condition:** Request timeout only when two requests raced on the same key

**Signal:** 30 second deadline in the gateway log

**Root cause:** Clock skew between the two hosts

**Fix:** Switched the deadline from wall-clock to monotonic clock

**Implementation:** PR #8269 on branch fix/request-timeout-1

**Reproduction:** POST /login twice against a warm cache

**Measured outcome:** Reclaimed 63 GB of blob storage

---

### Incident 2: 2026-06-09 - Timezone-aware datetime comparison
**Location:** services/auth/session_store.py (authentication side, same corner as Incident 1)

**Trigger condition:** Request timeout only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket

**Signal:** 30 second deadline in the gateway log

**Root cause:** Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime

**Fix:** Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge

**Implementation:** PR #9823 on branch fix/request-timeout-2

**Reproduction:** POST /login twice against a warm cache

**Measured outcome:** Throughput rose 66 percent to 695 requests per second

---

**Context:** Both incidents occurred in the same code section of services/auth/session_store.py on the authentication side, so context carried over from earlier request timeout work."}
